finding.title: Filtering the orders list with ?status=paid' OR '1'='1 returns orders of every status and customer.
finding.description: Filtering the orders list with ?status=paid' OR '1'='1 returns orders of every status and customer. Locate the filtering implementation.

source_files.content:
class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @orders = params[:status] ? Order.with_status(params[:status]) : Order.recent
  end
end

class Order < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :customer

  scope :recent, -> { order(created_at: :desc).limit(50) }

  def self.with_status(status)
    where("status = '#{status}'")
  end
end
